hypothesis: A 64-step differentiable tail can pass value-equivalence and measured-credit checks while computing the complete 1024-step source dynamics and all 512 settled frames for registered phase, Q, H, and RGB terms.

source.checkpoint: Whole immutable SW0097 positive_frozen core for each matched source seed 0, 1, and 2.
source.encoder: Registered SW0097 input encoder and frozen feature preprocessing; encoder remains trainable in the prospective pilot.
source.data: Per-seed exact SW0097 ordered 4096 TRAIN IDs and existing SW0106 byte-verified native RGB/gamma caches.
source.short_reference: Reuse already completed matched SW0117 seed0 and SW0122 seeds1/2 control and analytic-candidate artifacts after full validators pass. No short pilot is rerun.

late_rollout_foundation.prefix: Frames 0..959 run under no-grad; phase history, dendrite, membrane, and previous-spike values are preserved then detached at the boundary.
late_rollout_foundation.static_graph_and_drive: Prepared once with gradients enabled before burn-in and reused through prefix and tail; this preserves graph and oscillator-drive parameter paths without boundary recomputation.
late_rollout_foundation.scope: Truncated BPTT. This is not full 1024-step BPTT and does not claim gradients through the detached prefix.

training.optimizer: Fresh Adam over the full source core/graph and encoder; core/graph LR 3e-5, encoder LR 3e-6, combined gradient clip 1.
training.lambda: Immutable SW0117 seed0 first-four-TRAIN calibration; no recalibration or tuning.

preflight: For each seed, reproduce the same-input source no-grad full 1024 rollout exactly in theta, averaged/component membrane, averaged/component actual spikes, Q, production labels/H, phase-primary, positive-Q, and RGB forward values.
Use all 512 actual settled frames for phase, Q, hard production partition, and RGB loss; only the final 64 frames are live for gradients.

Check finite nonzero analytic-RGB gradients into encoder, graph, oscillator drive, dendrite, and membrane parameter families; perform one disposable matched B16 Adam update and verify expected trainable groups change.

Require the fresh corrected three-seed foundation proof, current source/cache/order, immutable SW0117 lambda record, and fully validated SW0117/SW0122 short references before preflight or training. Bind the proof SHA into each preflight and training manifest. No masks or GT reads in preflight/training.

evaluation.readout: Unchanged production actual-event/gate/four-component spike-product QCC, threshold 0.50, minimum size 2, largest-component background.
evaluation.original_qcc_source_reproduction: Verify the registered per-image SW0097 source endpoint before interpreting new results.

promotion.mean: All-three-seed late-candidate mean FG-ARI exceeds both the matched short analytic-candidate mean and the fixed SW0097 source mean.
promotion.individual: At least two of three seeds exceed the fixed SW0097 source FG-ARI.
promotion.paired_uncertainty: Resample identical 320-image indices across all three seeds; 10,000-draw 95% lower bounds must be strictly positive for late-minus-short and late-minus-source FG-ARI.
promotion.iou: All-three-seed means exceed matched Slot foreground IoU 0.20358913115224261 + 0.05 and matched-object IoU 0.20693697915214362 + 0.05.
promotion.failure: Close this recipe without changing tail length, objective, coefficient, or threshold and without expanding to the 70k scaling sweep.

prohibitions: No changes to production S2Net core/layers, phase dynamics, readout, gates, or classifier.
No GT/mask input to prediction, gamma, losses, or training.
No source checkpoint or historical SW0117/SW0122 artifact overwrite.
Do not describe 64-step tail credit as full-rollout BPTT or as evidence of stage performance before paired evaluations.
